## What does this change?

<!-- One line is fine, e.g. "Adds the OpenTelemetry community meetup on Nov 10". -->

### Adding or changing a side event?

- [ ] It's public (anyone can RSVP, even if it's paid)
- [ ] The `url` is the real RSVP or details page
- [ ] Times are Salt Lake City local time
- [ ] `submitted_by` is my GitHub handle and `last_verified` is today's date
- [ ] It follows the event Code of Conduct

The "Validate side events" check will tell you if anything needs fixing.
